title: The identity inventory: the measurement, and the checker's refusals
note: P0-R13 (D-2026-28). The independent-reader coverage number was measured by asking whether an action's name appeared anywhere in reconstruct.py's TEXT. A name in the module docstring that lists what the reader does NOT cover, in an anomaly message, or in a comment saying something is deliberately unhandled all counted as coverage; a handler written with single quotes counted as nothing. The answer it gave happened to be right, which is the state this repository treats as a defect: nothing would have said so when it stopped being. It is read from the parse tree now, and only from positions that decide which branch runs. I1-I6 attack that measurement. I7-I13 attack the checker's own refusals, which were almost entirely unexercised -- for a file whose whole job is to refuse, a branch nobody has seen fire is a branch nobody knows fires.

mutations.name: I1_coverage_is_measured_by_string_presence_again
mutations.rationale: the exact defect P0-R13 is about, restored: an action named in a comment or a docstring counts as independently reconstructed

mutations.name: I2_a_comparison_is_not_a_dispatch_position
mutations.rationale: an ``action == "x"`` handler stops counting, so coverage is understated and the number stops meaning what the inventory says it means

mutations.name: I3_a_membership_vocabulary_is_not_a_dispatch_position
mutations.rationale: the sets the second reader's ``in`` tests are written against stop counting, which is how almost all of its dispatch is spelled

mutations.name: I4_a_dispatch_table_key_is_not_a_dispatch_position
mutations.rationale: a table-driven handler becomes invisible to the measurement

mutations.name: I5_a_name_present_but_unhandled_is_reported_as_absent
mutations.rationale: the category that exists to make 'somebody might believe this is covered' visible collapses into 'not there at all'

mutations.name: I6_the_mentioned_but_unhandled_report_is_always_empty
mutations.rationale: the report is silent about exactly the case it was added for

mutations.name: I7_overstated_reader_coverage_is_not_refused
mutations.rationale: the inventory may claim an action is independently reconstructed when nothing reconstructs it, which is the claim this whole file exists to measure

mutations.name: I8_an_ACTOR_field_may_name_a_test_that_does_not_exist
mutations.rationale: a plausible-sounding test name is accepted as a binding, which is the defect that produced five of them in the first draft

mutations.name: I9_an_ACTOR_field_need_not_record_a_write_path_or_a_replay
mutations.rationale: an actor-bearing field is classified without saying where it is written or how it is replayed, so the classification stops being checkable

mutations.name: I10_a_role_the_schema_does_not_define_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a field may be classified with an invented role, and the four categories stop partitioning anything

mutations.name: I11_an_action_recorded_in_the_wrong_module_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: the table may describe a past layout of the package, which is how a review reads the wrong file

mutations.name: I12_no_durable_action_is_discovered_at_all
mutations.rationale: the universe being classified is empty, and a checker asked to classify nothing agrees with everything

mutations.name: I13_every_module_level_string_constant_is_a_durable_action
mutations.rationale: the action list fills with constants that are not actions, so 'every durable action is classified' becomes a statement about something else
